name: InfStones Blockchain Intelligence
description:
Ask Claude anything on-chain. InfStones Blockchain Intelligence connects Claude to multiple blockchains through read-only tools that return conclusions, not raw data — powered by InfStones' own node infrastructure.

Diagnose & optimize:
- Root-cause a failed transaction in one question (revert reason decoded)
- Get three-tier gas recommendations with congestion trends
- Estimate contract interaction costs via simulation before you commit
- Check observable contract risk signals (not a security audit)
- Follow the money: trace every internal transfer in a transaction — native + token flows, each hop labeled EOA or contract
- Summarize any address's recent activity, resolve ENS names, check network health and congestion, and get block-level activity summaries

Also included: token & NFT holdings, transaction history, and market data lookups.

Setup takes one click: connect with your InfStones account via OAuth and endpoints for both chains are provisioned automatically — no API keys, no configuration. A free plan is created for you; upgrade anytime in the InfStones API Dapp for higher limits.

Every tool is strictly read-only. This connector never initiates transactions, signs messages, or touches private keys. Price and market data are objective information, not investment advice.

_published_faq.name: How do I add InfStones Blockchain Intelligence to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add InfStones Blockchain Intelligence to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.infstones.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the InfStones Blockchain Intelligence MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: InfStones Blockchain Intelligence lists 17 MCP tools, including analyze_price_trend, check_contract_risk, check_network_health, check_nft_holdings, check_token_holdings, check_token_price, diagnose_failed_transaction, estimate_contract_interaction_cost, inspect_contract_interface, query_address_history, query_token_transfers, and recommend_gas_strategy.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to InfStones Blockchain Intelligence?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to InfStones Blockchain Intelligence in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.

_published_faq.name: Does InfStones Blockchain Intelligence MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: InfStones Blockchain Intelligence requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
InfStones Blockchain Intelligence is developed by InfStones. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
